The '''Birjis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Derora]] and [[Isamu]].
